facts.statement: An upcoming new TCG expansion for Free Realms was previewed, with a new artwork and cards shown in the post.
facts.quote: nova expansão TCG do Free Realms que vem aí

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quais são as Novidades? (Enquanto isso, Na Troca de Figurinhas do Free Realms)
article_summaries.summary: A Portuguese-language Free Realms news post (captured 2012-11-03) teasing an upcoming Trading Card Game (TCG) expansion. It shows a previewed new artwork featuring Baron Von Darkcheat, four new characters, and several new cards including Hero cards, and hints that a third expansion name is coming. The page gives no exact date and no card names, stats or prices.
